subject: science
domain: Waves and Their Applications in Technologies for Information Transfer
skillName: Using Light or Sound to Communicate

items.prompt:
To communicate means to
A) send a message
B) make a shadow
C) build a wall
D) run fast

Which uses light to send a message?
A) A flashing flashlight
B) A whistle
C) A drum
D) A bell

steps: A flashlight uses light to signal.

items.prompt:
Which uses sound to send a message?
A) A flashlight
B) A mirror
C) A whistle
D) A shadow

steps: A whistle makes a sound to send a message.

items.prompt:
Two friends too far to hear each other could communicate by
A) flashing a flashlight in an agreed pattern
B) whispering
C) staying silent
D) closing their eyes
items.answer: A) flashing a flashlight in an agreed pattern

steps: Light can be seen over a distance to send a message.

items.prompt:
A flashlight signal is too dim to see far away. To improve it, you could
A) use a brighter light or signal in the dark
B) turn it off
C) make it smaller
D) use no light
items.answer: A) use a brighter light or signal in the dark

steps: A brighter signal is easier to see over a distance.

items.prompt:
Before sending light or sound signals, two people should agree on
A) what the signals mean
B) the weather
C) their favorite colors
D) nothing

steps: Both must know what each signal means to understand it.

items.prompt:
A bell can call a family to dinner from far away because
A) the sound travels far and they know it means dinner
B) it makes light
C) it is shiny
D) it is quiet
items.answer: A) the sound travels far and they know it means dinner

steps: The sound carries the agreed message over the distance.

items.prompt:
Sound is useful for sending a message to someone you cannot see because
A) it can be heard even when you cannot see each other
B) it makes light
C) it only works up close
D) it needs a mirror
items.answer: A) it can be heard even when you cannot see each other

steps: Sound reaches people even when sight is blocked.
